# Glossary — Brioche & Four

Known mishearings from the on-device recognisers (fr-FR and en-US running together).
Claude uses this list to correct the transcript before extracting answers.
Format: what the recogniser writes → what was actually said. Add to it after every warm-up.

## Us / the engagement
- "5D", "cinq D", "EV", "FD", "effet dé", "F D E" → **FDE** (forward-deployed engineer)
- "Claude" heard as "clôde", "Claude e", "close" → **Claude** (the AI model)

## Client and brand
- "brioche et four", "brioche est four", "bris oche" (when about the company) → **Brioche & Four**
- "for naxa", "fort Naxa", "four Naxa", "ces Fornaxas" → **Fornaxa** (the oven maker they distribute)
- "four à sole", "four a sol", "four assole" → **four à sole** (deck oven)
- "pétrin", "pet rein", "pétrins" → **pétrin** (dough mixer)

## Business vocabulary
- "ERP", "heure pé", "E R P" → **ERP**
- "SAV", "ça V" → **SAV** (service après-vente / after-sales)
- "tournée", "tour née" → **tournée** (delivery round)
- "mise en service", "mise en serre vice" → **mise en service** (installation and start-up at the bakery)
- "K€", "caisse euros", "cas euros" → **k€** (thousand euros)

## Notes
- "four" is both part of the company name and the oven itself: only map it to **Brioche & Four**
  when the CEO talks about the company.
